info.name: Social Assistance Fund - Complete API
info.description: Run folders in numeric order against a local/demo database. Creates persistent synthetic staff, funds and applications. Import the accompanying environment and supply adminPassword locally. Tokens, IDs and optimistic versions are captured automatically. Every implemented controller endpoint plus public health/OpenAPI routes is included. See README.md in this package.

item.name: 00 - Health and API documentation
item.description: Public operational/documentation routes. Actuator uses its native response format; metrics and other management endpoints are intentionally blocked.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Run first after health checks. Starts a fresh demo run with unique emails, applicant identities and generated temporary staff password. Does not change the bootstrap administrator.

request.description: Captures this role's bearer token. Re-run if the token expires (default 15 minutes).

exec: throw new Error('Set adminPassword locally from PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env before running.');

item.name: 02 - Staff administration
item.description: Bootstrap admin creates one account of each staff role. Lifecycle requests target ONLY the extra demo admin, never the bootstrap admin. End by obtaining officer/approver tokens.

request.description: newPassword is optional; omit to preserve the existing password.
Captures this role's bearer token. Re-run if the token expires (default 15 minutes).
Captures this role's bearer token. Re-run if the token expires (default 15 minutes).

item.name: 03 - Geography
item.description: Discovers real integer geography IDs rather than assuming sub-county IDs. Applications send subCountyId only; countyId is for lookup navigation and search.

item.name: 04 - Social funds
item.description: Platform-admin-only CRUD. Slugs are generated by the service; archive toggles replace physical deletion.

item.name: 05 - Public self-registration
item.description: No authentication or applicant account. Captures only an opaque submitted receipt. Duplicate identity numbers are rejected.

item.name: 06 - Assisted application drafts
item.description: Creator-only draft editing; submission validates complete form data. Optimistic versions are captured automatically. No county field is sent in form bodies.

item.name: 07 - Approver workflows
item.description: Runs approval, rejection and return-for-correction on separate applications. Returned applications remain locked: amendment/resubmission is deferred and no endpoint is invented.

item.name: Rejection
item.description: Independent application; does not reuse an already-approved record.

item.name: Return for correction
item.description: Independent application; does not reuse an already-approved record.

item.name: 08 - Validation and access boundaries
item.description: Expected error responses are asserted rather than treated as runner failures. Does not change security configuration.

item.name: Approved application cannot enter review again
